subject: Post-call: token volumes, budget owner & approval path
messages:
From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finexa.com>, Procurement <procurement@finexa.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: token volumes, budget owner & approval path

Alex — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on the commercial pieces we need to progress to a pilot/PO: 

Call recap (short):
- Uses: chat + summary + light reranking for clinical QA workflows. Expected distribution: ~70% generation, 30% embedding/rerank.
- Technical fit: agreed — our dedicated pool + KV cache looks like the cleanest path for latency/SLA.

Open commercial items I promised to follow up on:
1) Economic buyer and budget owner — who signs off finance-side? (name + role + email)
2) Budget range (quarterly or annual) you’re comfortable discussing now — need a ballpark to map to committed tiers
3) Expected token volume profile (tokens/month or tokens/session) so we can model unit economics and recommended $/1M tokens
4) Approval path & timeline (legal, procurement, finance who signs)

Deliverables from our side:
- I attached a simple pricing workbook (RIF_token_pricing_calc.xlsx) with a few scenarios: pilot, 6‑month commit, and 12‑month commit.
- SOW template for pilot (SOW-template.pdf) — we can adapt per your procurement needs.

Can you confirm the economic buyer and give a best-effort budget range and token estimate? If it helps, we can propose two options:
A) Pilot: 1–2M tokens/month, convertible to committed credits
B) Committed: 6–8M tokens/month for 12 months — price improves materially at commit scale

Suggested next step: 30-min call with your procurement + finance to review workbook and confirm sign-off owner. Are you able to intro the correct finance contact?

Thanks — I’ll hold off on drafting a formal quote until I get confirmation on the buyer and budget owner.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: RIF_token_pricing_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-template.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finexa.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finexa.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: token volumes, budget owner & approval path

Thanks, Karthik — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Economic buyer: Maya Singh (CFO) — maya.singh@finexa.com. She signs off on any multi-quarter commitments. Procurement owns the budget execution but Maya is the approver for anything >$50k/quarter.

2) Budget range: for an initial production rollout in Q4 we have an internal budget band of ~ $75k — $180k per quarter depending on commitments and SLA.

3) Token volumes: early estimate from product/eng is ~3M tokens/month ramping to ~7–8M tokens/month within 3–4 months if pilot looks good. This is coarse but enough to model.

4) Approval path & timeline: procurement will draft the PO once we have pricing. Finance (Maya) will need a short memo and cost model; legal will do a quick review — likely a 2–3 week cycle from final SOW.

Happy to run the 30-min working session — I’ll loop procurement and Maya if you want me to.

—
Alex Morgan
Head of Product — Finexa Health
alex.morgan@finexa.com

From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finexa.com>, Procurement <procurement@finexa.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: recommended offer bands & approval ask for Finexa (RDW-2026-4521)

Laura / Steph — forwarding Alex’s answer above. Key asks for us: confirm the commercial levers we can use and whether we can greenlight the recommended offer that meets their $75k–$180k/Q band and projected volume ramp.

Topline proposal I want to send to Alex (subject to your ok):
- Pilot (3 months): 1.5M tokens/month, $950 per 1M tokens, $2k pilot credit, month-to-month
- Committed 12m: 6–8M tokens/month -> $850 per 1M tokens (with 10% overage protection and 30-day SLA credit)
- Allowed discount authority for AE: up to 18% off list for first year with finance sign-off required above that

Questions for finance/legal:
- Laura: can finance approve an initial pilot credit of $2k and the proposed $850 target for committed? If not, what’s the floor you need to stay above?
- Stephanie: any procurement/legal flags on the SOW template I attached earlier? We want to avoid back-and-forth that slows the 2–3 week timeline Alex mentioned.

If we have approval to present the pilot + 12m committed band, I’ll schedule the 30-min working session with procurement and Maya.

Thanks,
Karthik

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finexa.com>, Procurement <procurement@finexa.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: recommended offer bands & approval ask for Finexa (RDW-2026-4521)

Karthik — thanks for the clear proposal. Finance is comfortable with the structure below, with two minor asks (listed). Please feel free to share this with Alex/Maya as the commercial proposal.

Finance sign-off summary:
- Pilot: approved — $2k pilot credit is okay. Use a clean one-page memo for Maya showing net-first-year cost vs baseline.
- Committed pricing: floor of $820 per 1M tokens (that’s our internal floor given expected GPU/infra + support). You proposed $850; we can approve $850 as the presented committed price. If the customer asks for deeper discount, escalate to me for approval.
- Discount authority: AE can offer up to 18% off list as you suggested. Anything beyond that requires my written approval and either ARR commit or finance exec sign-off.

Operational asks:
1) Add a 30-day pilot conversion clause in the SOW (automatically converts to committed pricing if they hit X tokens/month) — Steph, can you add that to the template?
2) Provide the short memo for Maya: include 1) annualized cost @ 6M tokens/mo, 2) expected savings vs self-hosting estimate, 3) proposed SLA credits. I can sign that memo.

Karthik — you have the green light to present: Pilot @ $950/1M with $2k credit; Committed @ $850/1M with floor $820 and AE authority up to 18% off.

Laura Bennett
Director of Finance, GTM | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
